name: Locked in Chastity
source:
Jamie, being an airhead and a fan of gaming a bit too much, neglects his loyal girlfriend, Kim, and unknowingly worsens their relationship.
With the addition of William into the mix, will their relationship bitterly end?​

[From F95Zone]
